title: Bedrock Titan and AI21/Jurassic completions request body: top_p must be mapped to topP, since unmapped keys are forwarded verbatim and silently ignored
answers: Why does top_p have no effect on Bedrock Titan completions?
Which request field name does a Bedrock Jurassic (AI21) completion body use for nucleus sampling?
Where are MLflow completions parameters renamed to Bedrock request field names?
How do I add a new sampling parameter to the Bedrock Titan adapter without it being silently dropped?
body:
Path: Completions requests to Bedrock Titan (amazon.titan-*) and AI21 Jurassic (ai21.j2-*) models, which carry fields such as prompt, max_tokens, stop, n, temperature and top_p, pass through AWSTitanAdapter.completions_to_model and AI21Adapter.completions_to_model in mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py to build the outbound Bedrock body (textGenerationConfig for Titan, flat body for Jurassic).
Rule: Both adapters build the body with rename_payload_keys, which passes any key missing from its mapping through unchanged. Every caller field Bedrock understands needs an explicit entry; top_p -> topP was added to both mappings in AWSTitanAdapter.completions_to_model and AI21Adapter.completions_to_model.
Symptom: A caller who set top_p on a Titan or Jurassic completion got a normal successful response with no nucleus sampling applied, because Bedrock did not recognise the snake_case top_p key and ignored it.
Constraints: Applies to the Titan and Jurassic adapters only; the Converse path builds its inferenceConfig separately. When adding a mapping, pin the exact outbound key in a fixture, because the response can look correct even when the key is wrong.
applies: Bedrock Titan and AI21 Jurassic completions adapters in mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py; not the Converse or Anthropic/Gemini adapters.
says: Changing the top-p sampling slider has no effect on Amazon Titan text generations.
Nucleus sampling adjustments do not alter output variety for Jurassic completion models.
Make the AI gateway properly apply nucleus sampling parameters to Titan requests.
Prompt completions for Jurassic models appear to completely ignore the sampling threshold.
search: When building Bedrock Titan and AI21 Jurassic completions request bodies in mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py, AWSTitanAdapter.completions_to_model and AI21Adapter.completions_to_model must explicitly map top_p to topP using rename_payload_keys because unmapped keys are forwarded verbatim and silently ignored. This rule applies to completions for amazon.titan-* and ai21.j2-* models, but excludes the Converse path and Anthropic or Gemini adapters. When adding sampling parameter mappings, outbound keys must be pinned in tests/gateway/providers/test_bedrock.py:test_bedrock_request_response.
